text_block_list.name: Akari
text_block_list.text: We did it! Onii-chan, please praise Akari lots and lots♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やりましたぁ！
お兄ちゃん、
アカリをた～っくさん褒めてください♡

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Darling, darling♡ You'll give me a reward too, right? This time, it'll be lips to lips...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダーリンダーリン♡
私にも、
ご褒美くれるわよね？
今度こそ、
唇と唇でっ……！

text_block_list.name: Alshat
text_block_list.text: Aaahn♡ It's not fair that Akari-chan and Louise Marie-chan get all the attention♡ I want to give Cherry-chan some kisses too♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁん♡
アカリちゃんやルイズマリーちゃんばっかり、
ずるいです♡
ワタシもチェリーちゃんと、
ちゅっちゅしまぁす♡

text_block_list.name: Yori
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! That woman... she's still full of energy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
あの人、
まだまだ元気いっぱいって感じじゃない……！

text_block_list.name: Alshat
text_block_list.text: Yup♡ Vee-chan's filling me with power~ I'll gladly take you on for as many rounds as it takes, without ever letting my guard down♡~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ♡
ヴィーちゃんに、
力を貰ってますし──
何回戦でも、
気を抜かずにお相手しちゃいますよ♡

text_block_list.name: Alshat
text_block_list.text: Of course... It doesn't have to be a physical battle, either...♡ Shiritori will do♡ Or even butt wrestling♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん……
肉弾戦じゃなくて、
構いませんからね……♡
しりとりでも♡　
お相撲でも♡

text_block_list.name: Anemone
text_block_list.text: If you keep sprouting back like weeds... I'll cut you down. Over and over... as many times as it takes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
雑草みたいに、
生えてくるなら──
刈り取るだけです。
何度でも──

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Mone, that is far too lenient. You unfaithful goat-woman... now is the time to tear you out by the roots.
text_block_list.orig_text:
モネや、
手緩き事を言いなんし。
不貞の山羊奴──
今こそ根切りにしてくれようぞ。

text_block_list.name: Alshat
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ……
こわぁい♡
でも──

text_block_list.name: Alshat
text_block_list.text: Everyone, every single one of you... Let's clash until we're covered in sweat and bodily fluids, until we're a complete mess. Lay your hearts bare. At that moment... I'll hold you within my arms♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
みぃんな……
汗や汁まみれの、
ドロドロになるまでぶつかりあって。
心を晒して。
それから──
ワタシが、
抱いてあげますね♡
